definitions.explanation: A zero of the analytically continued ζ(s) outside its negative even integer zeros; the conjecture places every such zero on Re(s)=1/2.
A velocity field with zero divergence, so fluid volume is locally preserved.
A complex function whose analytic behavior encodes arithmetic data; the Riemann zeta entry gives a familiar prototype, not the elliptic-curve case itself.
A field whose description has local symmetry; Maxwell's equations are the abelian example, while Yang–Mills theory uses a non-abelian gauge group.
The zeta function's zeros govern fine error terms in prime-counting estimates, one analytical bridge to additive questions about primes.
π(x) counts primes no greater than x; the zeta entry introduces the analytic structure that informs prime distribution.
Each rectangular face diagonal must satisfy a²+b²=d², with a further space-diagonal constraint.
A rule applied repeatedly to a state produces an orbit; the Lorenz plate is a continuous-time analogue, not the Syracuse map.
Gauss–Bonnet connects integrated curvature to a topological invariant in two dimensions; Einstein metrics ask for a tensor-level curvature condition.
The squared distance between planar points is the sum of the squared coordinate differences.
A return map records a continuous flow each time it crosses a chosen section; C4 asks when that map first has a primitive period-three orbit.

machines.title: Lorenz trajectory
machines.description: Recompute the Lorenz trajectory used by the live plate; it is exploratory context, not a proof of C4.

definitions.explanation: The present expansion rate relating recession velocity to distance in the local linear regime.

machines.title: Independent-error comparison
machines.description: Compare the quoted SH0ES and Planck values under an explicit independent-error assumption; this is not a full systematic-error analysis.

definitions.explanation: Each body accelerates under the gravitational pull of every other body; small initial uncertainty can grow over long integrations.
The circular speed as a function of radius constrains the enclosed mass profile; the new plate contrasts a luminous disk with a halo contribution.

machines.title: Idealized disk and halo curves
machines.description: Compute a finite luminous-mass curve and add a smooth halo term.

definitions.explanation: For two distributions on cube positions, half the sum of their pointwise absolute differences measures their statistical separation.
Every quarter-turn, inverse quarter-turn, and half-turn of one face costs one move; the cited mixing problem uses this turn set.

machines.title: Reachable cube-state count
machines.description: Recheck the state-space size only; this small count does not estimate the lazy walk's mixing horizon.

definitions.explanation: A periodic n-body solution in which each body follows the same closed path with a fixed time shift.

machines.title: Figure-eight orbit integration
machines.description: Integrate the reference orbit and nearby initial conditions; numerical agreement or drift does not establish global uniqueness.
